component.name: Banshee
component.summary: Build a queue of music, videos and podcasts as fast as you type

description.p: Banshee is a queue-first player in the spirit of the classic Banshee. Search is focused when it opens: type, press Enter, keep typing. One queue mixes YouTube Music songs, YouTube videos, podcast episodes and Spotify tracks in any order.

ul.li: Instant fuzzy search that merges remembered and live results
Your YouTube Music and Spotify playlists, artists, albums, liked songs and podcasts
Queue, position and searches survive quitting
MPRIS media controls, Mini Mode and your current song as your Discord status
A fullscreen Touch Mode for tablets and 2-in-1s
Suggestions to keep going when the queue runs out, never played without a tap

description.p: This is an independent project, not affiliated with the original Banshee media player.

Touch Mode is a fullscreen layout for tablets and 2-in-1s: a large cover you can swipe to skip, big controls, and a queue built for fingers. Tap a row to play it, drag its grip to reorder, swipe it away to remove it with Undo. Add opens the search as a sheet. Portrait and split-screen windows stack the queue under the player. Press F11 or choose Touch Mode from the menu.

When nothing is up next, Keep Going suggests songs to add: YouTube Music's up-next for your last track, then your Quick picks. Nothing plays by itself. Once the queue has run out, anything you add starts playing.
Editing the queue no longer throws the list back to the top, and the now-playing marker and played dimming follow every track change. Undo notifications stay up for five seconds.
Banshee is now licensed under the Apache License 2.0. Versions up to and including 25.09.1 remain available under GPL-3.0-or-later. The Banshee icon keeps its MIT license.
Banshee now uses calendar versions (year, month, patch), following the freedesktop SDK.

Escape closes the Mini Mode search while you type. Narrow windows keep more of the Now Playing Bar on screen. Menus on playlists, albums and podcasts no longer offer actions that do nothing. The keyboard shortcuts window lists every shortcut, including Mini Mode.
Signing out of Spotify always sticks. The app no longer has access to your login keyring, and stream extraction ignores stray yt-dlp configuration files.
First search after launch no longer waits for the YouTube Music client; tracks start about twice as fast; the next track's stream is fetched once, ahead of time.
Source badges are readable in the dark style.
Rewritten in Rust with a queue-first layout, fast fuzzy search, videos, podcasts, Spotify, a library and durable app memory.
